system.description: Sometimes a smuggler has to fight his way out of a bad situation. If you fail any Deception check to convey deceptive information, you can initiate combat and make a single Unarmed attack as a Free Action in the Surprise Round (or with a melee or ranged weapon, if you have the Quick Draw feat); all other combatants are considered Surprised even if they are aware of you.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Force Unleashed Campaign Guide
